description: Source code for a sample application demonstrating OpenGL ES 2.0 instanced rendering with ANGLE extension, including shader setup, texture loading, and rendering loop.

classes.name: SimpleInstancingSample
classes.description: A class inheriting from SampleApplication that sets up and renders multiple instanced quads with textures using OpenGL ES 2.0 and ANGLE extension.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the shader program, loads textures, sets up vertex data, and prepares instanced rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up OpenGL resources such as shader program and textures.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering of the instanced quads, setting up viewport, binding buffers, and issuing draw calls.
